# Remove from each playlist songs released after 2021

# Build unique song ids across all playlist library entries
unique_song_ids=set()
for pl in playlists:
    for sid in pl.get('song_ids', []):
        unique_song_ids.add(sid)

unique_song_ids=list(unique_song_ids)
print('unique_song_ids_in_playlists', len(unique_song_ids))

# Determine which of these songs have release year > 2021
qualifying_song_ids=set()
info_by_song_id={}

for sid in unique_song_ids:
    det = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    release_date = det.get('release_date')
    year=None
    if release_date:
        year=int(release_date[:4])
    info_by_song_id[sid] = {
        'song_id': sid,
        'title': det.get('title'),
        'release_date': release_date,
        'year': year
    }
    if year is not None and year > 2021:
        qualifying_song_ids.add(sid)

print('qualifying_song_ids_after_2021', len(qualifying_song_ids))
print('qualifying_song_ids_sample', sorted(list(qualifying_song_ids))[:20])

# Build per-playlist removals
removal_plan=[]
for pl in playlists:
    pid=pl['playlist_id']
    song_ids=pl.get('song_ids', [])
    to_remove=[sid for sid in song_ids if sid in qualifying_song_ids]
    removal_plan.append({'playlist_id': pid, 'to_remove': to_remove})

# Print verification artifact counts
total_songs_in_qualifying=set()
for item in removal_plan:
    total_songs_in_qualifying.update(item['to_remove'])

print('total_unique_qualifying_songs_to_remove_across_playlists', len(total_songs_in_qualifying))
print('playlists_with_removals', sum(1 for x in removal_plan if x['to_remove']))
print('removal_counts_per_playlist', [(x['playlist_id'], len(x['to_remove'])) for x in removal_plan if x['to_remove']][:20])

# Execute removals
removed_actions=[]
for item in removal_plan:
    pid=item['playlist_id']
    for sid in item['to_remove']:
        res = apis.spotify.remove_song_from_playlist(playlist_id=pid, song_id=sid, access_token=spotify_token)
        removed_actions.append((pid, sid, res.get('message')))

print('total_removed_actions', len(removed_actions))
print('removed_actions_sample', removed_actions[:10])

# Verification 1: check remaining songs in library released after 2021
remaining_library_songs=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('library verify page_index', page_index, 'count', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    remaining_library_songs.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print('remaining_library_song_count', len(remaining_library_songs))

qualifying_remaining=[]
for s in remaining_library_songs:
    sid=s['song_id']
    det=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    release_date=det.get('release_date')
    year=int(release_date[:4]) if release_date else None
    if year is not None and year>2021:
        qualifying_remaining.append({'song_id':sid,'title':det.get('title'),'release_date':release_date,'year':year})
print('qualifying_remaining_after_2021_count', len(qualifying_remaining))
print('qualifying_remaining', qualifying_remaining)

# Verification 2: check each playlist for any remaining songs released after 2021
remaining_playlists=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('playlist verify page_index', page_index, 'count', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    remaining_playlists.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print('remaining_playlist_count', len(remaining_playlists))

# Build mapping playlist_id -> song_ids
songs_after_2021_in_playlists=[]
for pl in remaining_playlists:
    pid=pl['playlist_id']
    for sid in pl.get('song_ids', []):
        det=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
        release_date=det.get('release_date')
        year=int(release_date[:4]) if release_date else None
        if year is not None and year>2021:
            songs_after_2021_in_playlists.append({'playlist_id':pid,'song_id':sid,'title':det.get('title'),'release_date':release_date,'year':year})

print('songs_after_2021_remaining_total', len(songs_after_2021_in_playlists))
print('songs_after_2021_remaining_sample', songs_after_2021_in_playlists[:10])
